$doc: §23.6 ST-3. The levels are authored: StochasticUnitDefend stamps Hasty at occupation and climbs by sim time (600 s / 3600 s), so a play-driven version would need a 3700 s run; the combat reads AggregateUnit.Prepared directly (StochasticCombat.CoverFactor: 0.45 Prepared, 0.25 Fortified). The attackers are COMPANIES (90 men) against 30-man defenders so the losses are not one or two slots. Re-authored 2026-11-17 (R-8343) after agg-backend's CE-8009 (personal weapons at the measured 0.4 rounds a man a second, hits through the body's zones and armour): the order-less defenders broke contact under fire (our SOP, CE-8021) before a man was down, so they now DEFEND in place. Measured: fire opens at ~54 s (300 m); the first men fall within a second on both defenders, so a small loss count does not separate them - the half-strength line does: the Prepared defender has 15 down at 65.25 s, the Fortified one at 73.25 s.

expect.name: the Fortified defender is fought: a slot is down
the Prepared defender has lost half its men (15) by 70 s
the Fortified defender has NOT lost half its men by 70 s (it holds longer)
both defenders keep the level they were authored with
